submissionRequirements.physicalPolicy: Effective May 1, 2026, physical media is accepted only from artists within KKFI's listening area. Non-local physical submissions are returned to sender.

businessContact.emailStatus: protected first-party Music Librarian email link observed but not decoded or stored
businessContact.verification: KKFI's official New Music Submissions and Contact pages publish a protected email link for the Music Librarian and explicitly associate it with digital submissions and follow-up. Because the destination is protected in passive rendering, its exact syntax and domain were not asserted. The link was not decoded, guessed, contacted or probed, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability testing was performed.

formBoundary.widgetStatus: The official pages expose JavaScript-dependent contact widgets, but the passive Contact representation reports no fields and the widgets were not treated as the canonical music-delivery route.

activityVerification.evidence: KKFI's official homepage carried content dated July 8, 2026, current upcoming episodes, a recently played section, active programme navigation and a current event announcement.

genreFitEvidence: KKFI's official programme taxonomy includes Hip-Hop / Electronic and Reggae / World.
Current specialist shows include Dub's Groove, Galactic Supermarket, Global Roots Radio, HipHop Chronicles, Nocturnal Frequencies, Roots-Wise Reggae, Sunset Reggae and World Sound Radio.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, dub, reggae, world-fusion, hip-hop and crossover releases have plausible editorial fit.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KKFI expressly accepts digital music through its Music Librarian route, but the destination is published through a protected first-party email link and was not decoded, guessed or copied into the automated dataset. A human must open the current official page, use only the displayed destination, choose a rights-cleared MarcsMusic release, prepare the preferred 300 kbps constant-bitrate MP3 or a supported cloud-download link, keep any direct attachments below 8 MB total, confirm that no separate player is required, add accurate release and routing context, verify international eligibility and the unpublished explicit-content and AI-origin rules, and send manually. KKFI's updated May 2026 policy limits physical submissions to artists within its listening area, so MarcsMusic must not use the postal route.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open pull-request patch and repository code index were searched for KKFI, its frequency, canonical domain, current submission path and Music Librarian role. No prior music-submission-agent platform, seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: KKFI's digital Music Librarian route is stored once. The protected destination is retained as route metadata rather than decoded. The local-only physical route, generic JavaScript contact widgets, individual hosts and the older broad physical-mail wording are not counted as separate MarcsMusic opportunities.

notes: One new free-first digital music-submission route was queued as needs_manual_review. No email, file, link, form or physical package was submitted.
